```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
```

## Data Import

```{r}
restaurant_raw = read_csv(
  "data/restaurant_raw.csv.gz",
  col_types = cols(
    CAMIS = col_character(),
    ZIPCODE = col_character(),
    PHONE = col_character()
  )
) |>
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
dim(restaurant_raw)

glimpse(restaurant_raw)

n_distinct(restaurant_raw$camis)
```

## Missing Values

```{r}
missing_summary = restaurant_raw |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    percent = round(missing / nrow(restaurant_raw) * 100, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(missing))

knitr::kable(missing_summary)
```

## Duplicate Records

```{r}
sum(duplicated(restaurant_raw))

restaurant_clean = restaurant_raw |>
  distinct()

dim(restaurant_clean)
```

## Date Conversion

```{r}
restaurant_clean = restaurant_clean |>
  mutate(
    inspection_date = mdy(inspection_date),
    grade_date = mdy(grade_date),
    record_date = mdy(record_date)
  )

summary(restaurant_clean$inspection_date)

sum(
  restaurant_clean$inspection_date == as.Date("1900-01-01"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

## Data Quality Check

```{r}
restaurant_clean |>
  count(boro, sort = TRUE)

restaurant_clean |>
  count(grade, sort = TRUE)

restaurant_clean |>
  count(critical_flag, sort = TRUE)

restaurant_clean |>
  count(inspection_type, sort = TRUE)

summary(restaurant_clean$score)

sum(
  restaurant_clean$latitude == 0 |
  restaurant_clean$longitude == 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```
## Handling Invalid Values

```{r}
restaurant_clean = restaurant_clean |>
  mutate(
    boro = na_if(boro, "0"),
    latitude = na_if(latitude, 0),
    longitude = na_if(longitude, 0),
    inspected = inspection_date != as.Date("1900-01-01")
  )

dim(restaurant_clean)

table(restaurant_clean$inspected, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Valid Inspection Records

```{r}
inspection_records = restaurant_clean |>
  filter(
    inspected == TRUE,
    !is.na(inspection_type)
  )

dim(inspection_records)

summary(inspection_records$inspection_date)
```

## Inspection Consistency Check

```{r}
inspection_check = inspection_records |>
  group_by(camis, inspection_date, inspection_type) |>
  summarise(
    score_count = n_distinct(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade_count = n_distinct(grade, na.rm = TRUE),
    boro_count = n_distinct(boro, na.rm = TRUE),
    cuisine_count = n_distinct(
      cuisine_description,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inspection_check |>
  summarise(
    total_inspections = n(),
    score_conflicts = sum(score_count > 1),
    grade_conflicts = sum(grade_count > 1),
    boro_conflicts = sum(boro_count > 1),
    cuisine_conflicts = sum(cuisine_count > 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
